What is a DSCR loan in Florida

The investor mortgage that underwrites the property, not you

A DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) loan is an investment-property mortgage that qualifies you on whether a Florida rental's income covers its mortgage payment — not on your personal income. Because approval is based on the property's cash flow, there are no W-2s, tax returns, pay stubs, or debt-to-income calculations. Florida is one of the strongest DSCR markets in the country: year-round rental demand, top-tier short-term-rental metros, and no state income tax all help properties cash-flow. Cambridge Home Loan finances DSCR purchases, rate-and-term refinances, and cash-out refinances statewide — and, uniquely, funds the buy-and-rehab side too. This page covers the Florida program; see our nationwide DSCR program for the full guidelines.

What makes Florida different

Florida underwriting realities national lenders miss

Out-of-state lenders price Florida deals like any other state — then surprise you at the closing table. We underwrite for how Florida actually works.

Property insurance is the #1 DSCR factor

Florida premiums are among the highest in the U.S. and can swing your DSCR. Get a real quote early; a wind-mitigation inspection can cut the premium materially.

Flood zones & FEMA maps

Many Florida properties sit in flood zones requiring separate flood insurance. We flag this upfront so it's in your DSCR from day one, not a closing-day shock.

No state income tax

Florida has no state income tax, improving your net cash flow versus higher-tax states — a real edge when you're scaling a portfolio.

Property taxes can reset at purchase

Florida's Save Our Homes cap doesn't apply to investment property, so taxes can jump from the prior owner's assessment. We underwrite to the reassessed figure.

Short-term-rental rules vary by city

Miami Beach, Orlando, and Kissimmee each regulate STRs differently. We finance STRs statewide and help you confirm the property's zoning supports your strategy.

Foreign-national demand, especially Miami

South Florida draws heavy international investment. We offer foreign-national programs for qualified borrowers.

Investor strategy · whole-cycle financing

The BRRRR method in Florida — one lender, every step

BRRRR is a five-step cycle — one B and four Rs — that recycles the same capital into deal after deal. Most DSCR lenders only handle the refinance. Cambridge Home Loan finances the entire cycle, so you never have to stitch together a hard-money lender and a separate DSCR shop.

B

Buy

Acquire an undervalued Florida property with our fix-and-flip / bridge financing.

R

Rehab

Renovate to force appreciation and make the unit rent-ready.

R

Rent

Place a tenant so the property produces the income a DSCR loan needs.

R

Refinance

Roll into a long-term DSCR cash-out refinance and pull your capital back out.

R

Repeat

Redeploy that capital into your next Florida deal — and run it again.

95%LTC purchase
100%of rehab

CambridgeHomeLoan.com provides up to 95% LTC for the purchase and 100% of the rehab for your investment property — and when you are ready to cash out and refinance, we can quickly get you the funds you need to move on to your next investment project. That's the entire BRRRR cycle under one roof, so your capital keeps working instead of sitting idle between lenders.

How to qualify

What you need for a Florida DSCR loan

  • DSCR from 0.75x — 1.0x+ for standard pricing, 1.25x+ for the best terms.
  • 600+ FICO — higher scores unlock lower rates and higher leverage.
  • 15%–25% down (up to 85% LTV) on standard purchases.
  • A bound Florida insurance quote — get it early; it drives your DSCR.
  • 3–6 months reserves in liquid post-close funds.
  • No income docs — no W-2s, tax returns, pay stubs, or DTI calculation.

Answers

Florida DSCR loan FAQ

What is a DSCR loan in Florida?+
A DSCR loan is an investment-property mortgage that qualifies you on a Florida rental's income rather than your personal income. The lender divides gross monthly rent by the monthly PITIA payment; if the property covers its debt at the program's minimum ratio, you can qualify — with no W-2s, tax returns, or DTI calculation.
What credit score and down payment do I need in Florida?+
Minimum 600 FICO, with 15%–25% down (up to 85% LTV) on standard purchases. Higher scores improve both your rate and your maximum leverage. For BRRRR deals, Cambridge finances up to 95% of purchase cost (LTC) plus 100% of the rehab.
How does Florida property insurance affect my DSCR?+
A lot. Florida premiums are among the highest in the country and are part of the PITIA used to calculate DSCR, so a high quote can pull a strong-looking deal below the threshold. Get a bound quote early, and ask about a wind-mitigation inspection, which can materially lower the premium.
Can I use a DSCR loan for an Airbnb or vacation rental in Florida?+
Yes. Short-term and vacation rentals are eligible and especially strong in Orlando, Miami, and the Gulf coast. With no long-term lease, underwriting uses market rent from a Form 1007 appraisal. Confirm the city's short-term-rental rules before you buy, since they vary across Florida.
What are current DSCR loan rates in Florida?+
Rates start at 5.75% for the strongest borrowers (high FICO, lower LTV, 1.25x+ DSCR) and generally range up to about 9.5% for max-leverage or sub-1.0x scenarios. Your rate depends on credit, LTV, DSCR, property type, insurance, and prepayment structure, and is subject to change.
How do I calculate my DSCR?+
Divide gross monthly rent by total monthly PITIA (principal, interest, taxes, insurance, association dues). Example: $2,650 rent ÷ $2,120 PITIA = 1.25x. Use the Florida DSCR calculator on this page — it includes a higher insurance line by default.
Does Cambridge finance the purchase and rehab, not just the refinance?+
Yes — that's our edge over national DSCR lenders. We provide up to 95% LTC for the purchase and 100% of the rehab, and when you're ready to cash out and refinance, we quickly get you the funds to move on to your next project. The whole BRRRR cycle runs through one lender.
Can I close in an LLC?+
Yes. Florida DSCR loans commonly allow title in an LLC or entity for asset protection and clean books. You'll provide entity documents such as the operating agreement and EIN.
Can foreign nationals get a DSCR loan in Florida?+
Yes. South Florida sees heavy international investment, and we offer foreign-national programs for qualified borrowers, underwritten on the property's cash flow.
How fast can a Florida DSCR loan close?+
As fast as 14 days for streamlined files. The biggest timing variables are appraisal turnaround and getting your insurance quote bound — start the insurance early to keep the file moving.
Is there a prepayment penalty?+
Most DSCR loans carry a step-down prepayment penalty (for example 5-4-3-2-1, declining 1% per year). If you plan to sell or refinance early, ask about shorter prepay options in exchange for a slightly higher rate.
Do property taxes change when I buy in Florida?+
Often, yes. Florida's Save Our Homes assessment cap applies to homesteaded primary residences, not investment property, so your taxes may be reassessed above the prior owner's amount after purchase. We underwrite to the reassessed figure so your DSCR reflects reality.
